newsitem.title: CANADA: Rio Algom sees no reason for active stock.
newsitem.headline: Rio Algom sees no reason for active stock.

text.p: Shares in Rio Algom Ltd fell in heavy trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Monday, surrendering over half their gains from a rally on Friday.
Rio Algom sank 1.80 to close at 34 in turnover of 931,350 shares on Monday.
The stock soared 3.30 on Friday amid vague takeover rumors swirling around the Canadian copper producer.

"We looked pretty carefully at the trading pattern at the end of the day on Friday and we really are as much at a loss to explain it as anybody else," said Corey Copeland, vice-president of corporate affairs at Rio Algom.
Analysts said on Friday the market rumors had identified Toronto-based Noranda Inc as a likely suitor for Rio Algom.
"We have no reason to believe that they (takeover rumors) have any more truth to them than any number of other rumors that we've heard," Copeland said.
